title: Pregnant Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #05 (대각 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: French woman, an adult, in her mid 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, natural soft black hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real pores, real living eyes, 25 bars piercings set with rubies in silver-toned metal, wearing a single piece of silver earrings. Full body fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 28% of the way down her figure from the top, about 43% of the way down her figure from the top and about 64% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, wisteria formations in ELECTRIC VIOLET and STARK WHITE, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries solid polished rose-quartz stone fused directly into her own form, soft natural veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING soft pink stone surface with VIVID white vein striations. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
